footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes a $9.6M income tax benefit. The filing reports no separate capital expenditures, so free cash flow equals operating cash flow.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 28.6% to $290M in 2025. Gross margin was 77.2%, versus 71.6% a year earlier, and operating income was $24.0M, up from a $1.6M loss.
The net loss narrowed to $6.4M, or −$0.13 per share, from $32.9M. Operating cash flow was $56.5M and free cash flow $56.5M, versus $42.5M; MNTN returned $10.0M through buybacks.
watch: Net income includes a $9.6M tax benefit.
sources: MNTN, Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)

risks: Our revenue and results of operations are highly dependent on the growth and expansion of CTV, and performance marketers using CTV…
If we fail to attract new customers, or if our existing customers do not expand their usage of our platform, our growth will suffer
If we are not able to achieve our customers’ ROAS and other campaign goals, customers may reduce their overall ad spend
Our results of operations may fluctuate significantly and may not meet our expectations or those of securities analysts and investors
Seasonal fluctuations in the demand for the products of our consumer-facing and e-commerce customers could adversely affect our business…
strategy: Increase Our Share of Existing Customers’ Ad Spend
Develop and Promote the MNTN Brand
Extend Platform into Adjacent Markets and Channels
